I'll need both infrastructure and data governance to formally record their findings before I can approve. Who would like to go first?

The run can start on June 30, but that means decommission can't happen on June 30 itself — it would need to be pushed to at least July 2. I haven't updated the retirement ticket yet, but I'm recording this as my infrastructure finding now.
